title: Geometry - Lesson 9 Assessment: Multi-Step Parallel and Perpendicular Problems
description: Show mastery by solving mixed missing-angle problems and justifying each step with the correct relationship.

questions.question: Two parallel lines are cut by a transversal. Alternate interior angles $\angle 3$ and $\angle 6$ are shown. If $m\angle 3 = 79^\circ$, what is $m\angle 6$?
questions.explanation: Alternate interior angles are congruent when the lines are parallel, so angle 6 is 79°.

questions.question: Same-side interior angles formed by parallel lines measure $x^\circ$ and $124^\circ$. Which equation finds $x$?
questions.explanation: Same-side interior angles are supplementary, so their measures add to 180°.

questions.question: A line perpendicular to another line forms angles that each measure ______ degrees.
questions.explanation: Perpendicular lines form right angles, and each right angle measures 90°.

questions.question: A $90^\circ$ angle is split into angles of $27^\circ$ and $y^\circ$. What is $y$?
questions.explanation: The two angles split a right angle, so $y = 90 - 27 = 63$.

questions.question: In a mixed diagram, all angles formed by a transversal across parallel lines must have the same measure.
questions.explanation: Some pairs are congruent, but adjacent linear pairs and same-side interior angles are supplementary.

questions.question: Angle 1 measures $68^\circ$. Angle 2 corresponds to angle 1. Angle 3 forms a linear pair with angle 2. What is $m\angle 3$?
questions.explanation: Angle 2 is 68° by corresponding angles. Angle 3 is supplementary to angle 2, so $180 - 68 = 112$.

questions.question: Same-side interior angles have measures $3x^\circ$ and $120^\circ$. Find $x$.
questions.explanation: Because same-side interior angles are supplementary, $3x + 120 = 180$, so $3x = 60$ and $x = 20$.

questions.question: Parallel lines are cut by a transversal. Angle A is $52^\circ$. Angle B is alternate interior to angle A. Angle C is vertical to angle B. Find $m\angle C$ and justify the answer.
questions.correctAnswer: $m\angle C = 52^\circ$. Angle B is 52° because alternate interior angles are congruent, and angle C is 52° because vertical angles are congruent.
questions.explanation: This is a two-step congruent-angle chain: alternate interior first, then vertical angles.

questions.question: A diagonal transversal makes a $36^\circ$ angle with a horizontal line. A vertical line is perpendicular to the horizontal line. Find the acute angle between the diagonal transversal and the vertical line, and explain your reasoning.
questions.correctAnswer: $54^\circ$, because the horizontal and vertical lines form a right angle and $90^\circ - 36^\circ = 54^\circ$.
questions.explanation: The transversal and vertical angle complete the right angle after the 36° angle is removed.

questions.question: A student says: 'The given angle is $70^\circ$, so the adjacent linear-pair angle is also $70^\circ$.' Correct the reasoning.
questions.correctAnswer: The adjacent linear-pair angle is $110^\circ$, not 70°. Linear pairs are supplementary, so $180^\circ - 70^\circ = 110^\circ$.
questions.explanation: Adjacent linear-pair angles usually are not equal; they add to 180°.
